claim_summary: For the specified elliptic curve over \(\mathbb C(w,t)\), the Mordell–Weil ranks in the cyclic quartic tower \(\mathbb C(w,t)\subset\mathbb C(v^2,t)\subset\mathbb C(v,t)\), \(w=v^4\), are exactly \(6,8,12\); the order-four rational character is \((12,4,4,4)\).
integrity: A complete exact-rational checker is embedded; its checks were executed. All cited prior results retain their authorship; the comparison does not establish exhaustive global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Rank and representation are over complex two-variable function fields, not over number fields.
No saturated integral invariant basis, quotient compactification, or independent validation is asserted.
The proof depends on the published full-rank theorem, polynomial section formulas, and elliptic-fiber intersection rules.
title: A cyclic quartic Mordell–Weil rank tower of \(6\), \(8\), and \(12\)
